_comment: Phase 18 checks, rerun in phase 20 after the back-silk mark change, of the 15 V Board P draft PCB (unvalidated draft, no layout review). DRC: native KiCad 10.0.6 kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones --schematic-parity, run as heavy-guard -> flock /tmp/kicad-native.lock, with board-p15.kicad_sch beside the draft in a scratch tree. The as-built row is the phase 15 run of the unchanged as-built board. ERC: kicad-cli sch erc on board-p15.kicad_sch. RESET scans: scripts/pcb/board-p-reset-clearance.py (same layer, and in-plane to the other copper layer with --cross-layer); the HV set includes VDD_LOC and VDD_MID. Net parity: scripts/pcb/board-p15/pcb-net-parity.py against board_p15_spec.py (net-parity.json).

drc.new_warnings: None in a silk class beyond the as-built board: silk_over_copper 2 (J1 circle, R12 reference over D5) and silk_edge_clearance 2 (J2/J3 edge lines), both as built; silk_overlap 0. Phase 18 hid the added supplier fields on F.Fab, moved the J2 SCL/SDA, J3 VBUS and U1 reference texts, and put the C30 reference on F.Fab (C38 occupies its as-built spot). lib_footprint_mismatch 27 and text_height 16 are as-built artwork classes.
drc.schematic_parity_note: extra_footprint only: MH1, MH2 and MH3, the mounting holes with no schematic symbol, which the exporter rule allows.
drc.phase20_note: Phase 20 (review F5): the back-silk mark rev2 reads 'P15 r1', moved 3.071 mm up so it ends where rev2 ended. Placed at the rev2 anchor it reached y=42.26 mm and added one silk_edge_clearance warning; after the move every DRC, parity and ERC count equals phase 18.

erc.note: all from the STUSB4500 symbol unspecified pin types

target: RESET copper at least 1.0 mm from VBUS_IN, VBUS_VS_DISCH, DISCH, VBEN, VBUS_OUT and Q1_G copper on its layer (the LED proposed 1.0 mm RESET strap keep-out; no manufacturer source)
as_built_reference: same-layer 0.222 mm (R13 pads) and 0.325 mm (VBUS_VS_DISCH via); other-layer 0.0 mm (B.Cu VBUS_OUT and VBUS_VS_DISCH tracks under the RESET track)
